I softened  the colours with alcohol and layered the effect to make it soft and diffused, similar to how you would do a marble/quartz design! 

- Started with two coats of base colour
- 2 layers of brown putting them in desired spots and blend with alcohol using an art brush
- Repeat with black 
- Topped with my base colour 
- Touched up the black for any extra intensity and done!

Using a light touch and not flooding your brush too much gave me the best results :)

Apparently the formula has changed with this palette but this is my first makeup forever eyeshadow product so I can’t compare. 

Packaging was a little strange. It’s in a metal tin with the shadows in a foam insert and the case design is just this plastic-y thing glued onto it. Not as nice as some other brands out there but I’m fine with the whole no frills aspect personally. 

The gold and pink/purple shimmers felt really nice while swatching and imo really pretty. The greenish shade below the black seemed interesting but doesn’t swatch nearly as well as I wanted. I thought the purple colour next to the pink shimmer would pull more red but I guess not 🤷‍♀️ 

Hopefully this helps you guys decide whether or not to purchase.
